item_short_desc: Keep your dive goggles and lenses clear with McNett Sea Drops!
description: Keep your goggles and lens' clear with McNett Sea Drops! These Sea Drops are formulated with a concentrated 2-in-1 liquid. It cleans and provides anti-fog protection, allowing crystal-clear vision when diving. McNett Sea Drops are safe for all dive lenses and is non-toxic, alcohol-free. They also work well with tactical goggles, eye and sunglasses, face masks and more.
